carousels.name: 1 in 10 men struggle to control sexual urges

slides.kicker: You are not the only one
slides.title: About [[1 in 10 men]] say they can't control their sexual urges — p*rn included.
slides.sub: What a major U.S. study found.

slides.title: Of men [[struggle]]
slides.body: In a JAMA Network Open study (2018) of 2,325 U.S. adults, 10.3% of men and 7% of women reported real distress from trouble controlling sexual urges and behavior.

slides.title: Look around [[the room]]
slides.body: In a class of 30 guys, statistically about 3 are fighting this — many with p*rn as the main outlet. Most will never say a word.

slides.title: Common ≠ [[okay]]
slides.body: Being normal doesn't mean it's fine. If p*rn is hurting your sleep, focus or relationships, it's worth fixing. Common problems still need real solutions.

slides.title: What to [[do]]
items: Get screened by a professional if it's severe.
slides.note: Send this to one friend. Statistically, it might be him ↗

1 in 10 struggle.

slides.title: Signs [[1–4]]
items: You're tired of the cycle, not just the guilt.

slides.title: Signs [[5–7]]

carousels.name: Nobody is coming to save you from p*rn

slides.title: Nobody is coming to save you from p*rn. [[Get up.]]
slides.sub: Not a partner. Not a perfect morning. Not next Monday.

slides.title: No perfect [[partner]]
slides.body: A relationship won't magically fix your p*rn addiction. You'll bring it with you.

slides.title: No perfect [[moment]]
slides.body: There's no day you'll wake up and stop wanting p*rn. You decide — and then you keep deciding.

slides.title: No more [[excuses]]
slides.body: Stressed. Tired. Busy. Lonely. All true. None of them make p*rn the answer. Your excuses are real. So is your responsibility.

slides.title: But you're [[not alone]].
slides.body: Nobody will do it for you — but plenty of people will do it with you. Take the first step. Then ask for help with the next one.
slides.note: Needed to hear this? Save it for the next time p*rn tempts you 🔖

carousels.name: Relapsed during NNN? Your next 72 hours

slides.title: Your next [[72 hours]] after a p*rn relapse decide everything.
slides.sub: Hour by hour. Save this for when you need it.

slides.title: Stop the [[spiral]]
slides.body: Close the tab. Leave the room. Drink water. One p*rn relapse is a moment. A binge is a choice.

slides.title: Find the [[trigger]]
slides.body: Write it down: time, place, mood, what happened before you opened p*rn. No shame — just data.

slides.title: Close the [[gap]]
slides.body: Fix the exact thing that let p*rn in: block that site, move the phone, plan that hour differently.

slides.title: Get [[back on track]]
slides.body: Restart your count. Rejoin NNN — 19 days is still a real streak. Day 3 after a relapse beats Day 0 forever.
slides.note: Send this to someone who just relapsed. They need it more than a lecture ↗
